comments: Van der Kuijp ([H9MPLMTV]) proposed the dates (?-1185). The terminus ante quem for gTsang nag pa's death was pushed to 1192 by Schwabland ([Q8WU9EDW]: 794, n. 3) on account of the date of Khro pu lo tsA ba (ID:3878)'s studies with gTsang nag pa. This date was corrected to 1195 based on Khro phu lo tsA ba's biography (van der Kuijp, personal communication).
